desc:
Document reading for PDFs, scans and photos turns paper trails into searchable, copyable text. Ecom Swift LLC sets up a reading flow in your own folders that keeps tables in order and flags any page it is unsure about.

## What is document reading for PDFs, scans and photos?

Document reading, often called optical character recognition, is the process of converting an image of text into real text a computer can search and copy. A scanned letter is only a picture until it is read. After reading, you can search for a name across a thousand pages, paste a paragraph into an email or move a table into a sheet.

Our version adds care around the hard parts: tables, columns, stamps, poor lighting and pages the reader cannot trust. Those pages are flagged for a person instead of being silently guessed.

## Why unreadable files slow everyone down

A folder of scanned files looks organized but behaves like a stack of photographs. You cannot search it, so people open files one by one hoping to find the right one. Copying a figure means retyping it, and each retyping risks a mistake. Phone photos of receipts sit in a camera roll, unnamed and out of order.

The problem grows with time. Each month adds more pages, and the cost of finding anything rises. When an auditor, customer or colleague asks for a document, the answer takes an afternoon instead of a minute.

## How readable text changes your daily work

Once pages are turned into text, search works across the whole archive. You can look up an invoice number, a client name or a clause and land on the right page. Text can be edited, quoted and checked, and tables can be moved into a sheet where totals can be calculated.

It also opens the door to later steps such as pulling out fields, summarizing or sorting by type. Reading quality depends on the source: clean digital PDFs read very well, while faded copies, creased receipts and handwriting vary a great deal. That is why we test on your own samples before promising anything about a folder.

## What a good reading set-up includes

- Support for digital PDFs, scanned PDFs and photos taken on a phone.
- Correction of tilt, shadows and uneven lighting before the page is read.
- Tables and columns kept in their original order, not merged into one stream.
- Output in the form you need: plain text, Word or a sheet.
- Searchable PDFs that look the same as the original but can be searched.
- Flags on pages with low reading confidence, so a person checks them.
- Sensible file names and folders, sorted by document type.
- Handling of one or two languages, tested on your samples.
- A test of handwriting on your own examples, with honest notes on the result.

## What we do

You send a sample folder that covers the best and worst of your material. We read it, compare the output against the pages by eye and write down where the reader struggles. If a different scan setting or file format would help, we tell you.

Then we build the flow in your own storage or workspace, so new files dropped in a folder are read and saved to a results folder. The Basic package covers a batch of clean digital pages with one page checked by hand. Standard adds scans and phone photos, table layout and an unsure-pages flag. Premium covers a larger set, a second language, handwriting tests, naming and sorting by type and a short guide so you can run it yourself.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Scan at a clear, steady resolution with the page flat and well lit.
- Send a few of your worst pages in the sample, not only the best.
- Keep the original files next to the read versions.
- Check flagged pages before using their text for anything important.
- Name the languages in your documents up front.

**Avoid:**
- Photographing pages at an angle or with a shadow across the text.
- Assuming handwriting will read as well as print.
- Deleting originals once text exists.
- Merging scans of different quality into one batch without testing.
- Relying on a single read for figures that drive payments.

## Who this service is for

It suits a small clinic or law practice with years of scanned correspondence that nobody can search. It suits a bookkeeper receiving phone photos of receipts from clients. It also suits a family business digitizing paper records, where the first task is simply being able to find things again.

## What we need from you

Send a sample folder of your documents, the output format you prefer and a note on any pages that are private. We will tell you where the work will run and where results are saved. We never ask for passwords. When the files live in cloud storage, you invite us as a collaborator on a single folder, and you can remove that access when the work ends.
